_comment: UC-BANK-02 Bank Counter. 12.6: a generic counter with no real bank branding anywhere, three account cards (the minor account only for under-18s), an illustrated form with a nominee, and a welcome kit whose PIN screen dims when someone walks past — that moment is the lesson, not decoration. Sets hasBankAccount, which every later Everyday Money game depends on.
_nominee: 12.6 asks for a one-line 'why nominee' explanation on the form rather than a separate lesson.
_pin: The passer-by appears partway through entering the PIN. Nothing is scored on it; the point is that the student notices the screen change and learns to shield it.
